title: HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning
abstract: arXiv:2605.05951v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World models support model-based planning through learned latent dynamics, but imagined rollouts can become unstable as the planning horizon grows or the dynamics distribution shifts. We propose HaM-World, a structured world model that combines history-conditioned selective memory with a Soft-Hamiltonian latent dynamics prior. The latent state is decomposed into a canonical (q,p) subspace and a context subspace c. Mamba selective state-space memory summarizes past observations and actions and conditions the same latent transition used for prediction, reward and value estimation, imagined rollouts, and cross-entropy method planning. The (q,p) subspace follows an energy-derived Hamiltonian vector field augmented with learnable residual and control dynamics, while c represents semantic, dissipative, and other non-conservative factors. translated_title: HaM-World：用于规划的具有选择性记忆的软哈密顿世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型通过学习到的潜在动力学支持基于模型的规划，但随着规划时域的增长或动力学分布发生偏移，想象展开可能变得不稳定。我们提出HaM-World，这是一种结构化世界模型，它将历史条件化的选择性记忆与软哈密顿潜在动力学先验相结合。潜在状态被分解为规范 (q,p) 子空间和上下文子空间 c。Mamba选择性状态空间记忆总结过去的观测和动作，并为同一潜在转移提供条件，该潜在转移被用于预测、奖励与价值估计、想象展开以及交叉熵方法规划。(q,p) 子空间遵循由能量导出的哈密顿向量场，并增强了可学习的残差和控制动力学，而 c 则表示语义、耗散以及其他非保守因素。在六个DeepMind Control Suite任务上，HaM-World在四个任务中排名第一，在两个任务中排名第二，取得了……
tldr: HaM-World将Mamba选择性记忆与软哈密顿潜在动力学先验相结合，通过把潜在状态分解为规范 子空间和上下文子空间，在长时程规划和动力学分布偏移下实现更稳定的想象展开，并在DeepMind Control Suite任务上取得领先性能。
en_tdlr: HaM-World combines Mamba selective memory with a Soft-Hamiltonian latent dynamics prior, decomposing the latent state into canonical (q,p) and context subspaces to achieve more stable long-horizon planning and leading performance on DeepMind Control Suite tasks.
